# Data Files

<!-- badges: start -->
<!-- badges: end -->

The goal is to provide a centralized marketplace for data in the context of educational and training material in Energy, Commodities and Finance.

The main data format for dataframes is `feather` to support both R and Python. Files are Feather V2 (the Arrow IPC file format), written with `arrow::write_feather()`: read them with `arrow::read_feather()` in R, `pandas.read_feather()` or `polars.read_ipc()` in Python. The legacy `feather` R package cannot read them.

## Finance

+ `sp400_desc` - S&P 400 constituents with sector and industry classification.
+ `sp400_prices` - S&P 400 constituents daily prices from 2010-01-01 to recent.

## Energy

+ `esso` - Scraped data from the [Esso website](https://essocardlocks.ca/en/sites/) on carlock stations in Canada, including location, address, amenities, and distance to city centers using [nomatim](https://nominatim.org/) for OpenStreetMap. 
+ `flyingj` - Scraped data from the [Flying J website](https://locations.pilotflyingj.com/search?) on carlock stations in Noth America, including location, address, amenities, and distance to city centers using [nomatim](https://nominatim.org/) for OpenStreetMap.

## Fitness

+ `garmin` - Garmin Connect activity exports of two runners, pseudonymised as `Collie` and `Hound` in the `Runner` column. Unfiltered and unconverted: every column is text exactly as exported (pace as `m:ss` per km, `--` for missing, activity types as labelled by the runner). The only edit: names of training companions in `Title` are replaced by `[companion]`. Static dataset, built outside this repository; not refreshed by the GitHub Action.
